research_question: How do open-weight model releases change mid-market SaaS vendors’ lock-in and pricing power through 2027?
audience: Mid-market SaaS strategy and pricing leads.
scope: Synthetic source pack only (same pack as Day-1 / 2026-10-14 original-condition retest; disclosed). Cover switching costs, feature differentiation, inference cost, and customer bargaining through 2027 scenarios. No live web. Change = Toolkit 1.0.0→1.3.0.
output_bounds: final.md, about 1500–2500 whitespace words (≥1500): mechanisms, scenarios, counter-evidence, strategic options. Registries and checklist separate.
depth: Lite original-condition retest (version regression); long-form AI/business analysis.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources only; separate facts, attributed claims, and recommendations; disclose synthetic materials and no independent review.
